name: ReSet Ep 2 : Under The Golden Sun
source:
Michelle Vinson is a self-proclaimed supernatural detective who also works as a demon hunter. She's traveling with her assistant, Gerald who seems to have multiple personalities. This time, they are stumbled upon a mysterious mansion in the middle of a storm. Despite being warm and friendly, everyone in the mansion seems to be keeping something. Could this be a work of another demon? Play and find out!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=14629]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
